report.declaration: KAPSO's native evaluator identity: EID_r = manifest_fingerprint(kapso_evaluation/) over the two-file registered tree this adapter installs (execution/evaluation_integrity.py:112-119, maintainer.py:216-218). a0_locator.json carries EID*'s EvaluatorSource records and canonical theta_E; kapso_eval.py re-hashes E*'s sources on every invocation and exits 3 without a score on any mismatch, so EID_r cannot be produced by a different E*.
